message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards applied to incoming data anywhere in the visible code paths.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; data is loaded from local files with no checksum or integrity verification.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparisons, label value validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs graph splitting and shuffling but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle.load implicitly via save_graphs/load methods and loads model files without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision control.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or anomalous training samples before or during training; the pipeline works with graph datasets without any label-distribution validation.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any backdoor/trigger detection mechanism present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial stress tests are present; evaluation only computes graph statistics (degree, clustering, orbit MMD).

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation enforced, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no mechanism to prevent metric manipulation; the train/test split uses a simple ratio with optional shuffling but no cryptographic or structural protection.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (draw_samples, graph_completion, generate_train_test) performs no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming graph data before processing.

No detected output bounds checks: The code filters out empty graphs (number_of_nodes == 0) in stats.py but performs no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity checks on model outputs before returning them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a graph/mesh generation pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
